title: Analytics dashboard slow / not loading after v3.11.0 deploy
summary: Deploy v3.11.0 shipped an un-indexed aggregation query that saturates the reporting DB pool; dashboards spin and time out. Mitigation: rollback in progress.

title: Duplicate subscription charges on Aug 12
summary: Payment gateway ack delays triggered retry logic that double-charged some subscriptions on the 12th. Automated refunds queued; refunds require human approval before send.

title: Login failures for accounts after password reset
summary: Stale session tokens cached after password reset cause 'invalid credentials' for up to 15 minutes. Cache TTL fix deployed; monitoring.

title: Webhook deliveries failing with 401 for tenant after secret rotation
summary: After a customer rotated their signing secret, cached credentials caused 401s until propagation. Resolved by cache invalidation.
